title: memory: Mailbox counts only written on insert, and wrong there
description: memory/mod.rs:314-334 insert_email; update/destroy/batch destroy never adjust totalEmails/unreadEmails/totalThreads/unreadThreads; insert bumps thread counts only for account-new threads, ignores $draft and all-read threads. RFC 8621 §2. history.rs check_mailbox_restore/rejoin_thread depend on this. Compute counts on read or maintain them. (probe-confirmed) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
